entries.t: <FACE:05>It's kind of noisy…<NL>Someone in the back?<WAIT><FACE:04>I've got a bad<NL>feeling…
<FACE:49>Are you in trouble,<NL>beautiful lady?<WAIT>Shall we lend you<NL>a hand?
<FACE:72>(Oh! What cute boys!?<NL> Three! Super lucky!)
<FACE:4A>Our Medabots pack<NL>quite a punch<WAIT><FACE:4B>And if it goes well…<NL>lunch, maybe?
<FACE:70>Forget that!<WAIT><FACE:70>Leave this lot to it!<NL>Lunch, right now!<WAIT>By the way, you boys…<NL>join the Sperobos?<WAIT><FACE:72>With my connections,<NL>I'd make you Bosses
<FACE:71>Well, I'm heading off<NL>You lot do it right!
<FACE:00>That's definitely…<WAIT><FACE:05>The Space Robo Robo<NL>Gang again?!<WAIT><FACE:05>And those with them…<NL>boys from our class!<WAIT><FACE:01>What are they up to?<NL>Let's watch a while…
<FACE:05>Still, what is that?<NL>A Boss, maybe…<WAIT>That flashy, tacky<NL>getup of hers…
<FACE:70>So you're the ones…<NL><WAIT>the middle schoolers<NL>getting in our way…
<FACE:49>What?! Getting in the<NL>way of this beauty?!
<FACE:03>Huh?! No, um, these<NL>guys are…<WAIT><FACE:49>And now he calls us<NL>«these guys»!<NL><WAIT>What a guy, <PLAYER>!
<FACE:49>Just watch us, miss!<NL><WAIT>We'll keep you safe,<NL>we promise!
<FACE:49>Darn! <PLAYER>, when'd<NL>you get one so tough?<WAIT><FACE:71>Hmph! You boys were<NL>all show and no use!
<FACE:05>That's the sort she is<NL><WAIT>You lot could use a<NL>hard lesson sometime
<FACE:72>Want to join big sis<NL>in the Sperobo Gang?<WAIT>Oh? You want to know<NL>who big sis is?
<FACE:72>Oh ho ho ho! My name…<NL>Space Robo Robo Boss:<WAIT>«The Ultimate<NL>Beautiful Madonna»<WAIT>The goddess of beauty!<NL>Sekiran of the Sea!
<FACE:71>Oh, shut up!<NL>Details don't matter!<WAIT><FACE:72>Heeey, cute boy over<NL>there!
<FACE:03>Y-yeah…<WAIT><FACE:72>Heh-hmmm…<NL><WAIT>The boy doesn't look<NL>all that against it…<WAIT>More my type than that<NL>gloomy kid, anyway

<FACE:04>A gloomy kid?<WAIT><FACE:70>That's right!<NL><WAIT>We caught a gloomy kid<NL>about your age lately<WAIT>Smog, one of my crew,<NL>saw promise, took him<WAIT>Well, two gloomy sorts<NL>might hit it off!
<FACE:70>Oh, I don't know his<NL>name<WAIT><FACE:72>He wasn't cute, so I<NL>wasn't interested!<WAIT><FACE:71>Same goes for you!

<FACE:01>Never mind that! What<NL>are you lot doing?!<WAIT><FACE:72>What, you ask?<NL>Isn't it obvious?<WAIT>We'll flood this place<NL>and block the way!<WAIT>So you lot won't get<NL>any further!<WAIT><FACE:00>So that's why you hit<NL>the water tank…<NL><WAIT>But if you break it…<NL>can you get away?
<FACE:70>…Can't be helped…<NL><WAIT>The flood plan is off!<NL>Lucky kids, you lot!
<FACE:03>No, um… that plan was<NL>never going to work…
<FACE:19>The back's got me<NL>curious, I tell ya
<FACE:49>Raiu joined the team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:4A>Harou joined the team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:4B>Kikou joined the team!
